Details 
 Add a bit of personality to your classic cowboy look with the Wrangler Retro® premium long-sleeve linen western snap shirt. Inspired by the patterns of the Wild West, this shirt blends the styling of a traditional snap shirt with a light blue pattern. Made from a lightweight linen blend, this long-sleeve modern slim fit shirt is perfect for transitioning between seasons. It also comes with pointed front and back yokes, contrast trim, snap cuffs, and a full pearl snap closure. Complete the look with your favorite Wrangler® jeans.
